state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `math-abs-result-is-the-whole-union` is closed. `Core\Math::abs` takes a bounded type variable, `CoreTy::Bounded("T", int|float|decimal)`, so its result is the argument's own type, and a `string` argument is still refused at compile time. `CoreTy::Bounded` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs` owns the rule; `MethodSig::type_bounds` carries it and `check_generic_args` in `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/args.rs` applies it. A `uint` argument is now returned unchanged, so `abs(UINT_MAX)` no longer throws. `tests/conformance/core/math-abs-answers-the-type-it-was-given.nvst` and `math-abs-refuses-an-argument-outside-its-number-types.nvst` pin both halves. `Core\Math`'s perf is re-measured.

`CoreTy::Bounded` is spelled by its name, so the reference prints `abs(T $n): T` as it prints `min`, and the spec row says what `T` may be. A first-class `Core\Math::abs(...)` is typed with each bound in place of its variable.

`startsWith` and `endsWith` still compare bytes, so `startsWith("e\u{301}", "e")` is `true`. The goal prose lists the search family without them, and whether they join it is still open.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

A change to a `Core` implementation file stales the perf figure of every feature it implements. Re-measure each with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\<Class>'` (the group is the full class name).

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest: 29 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.
